class_guess: Fossil bouncer: one bounce per cycle over a sea of u = 01001111 with seams; the wall leaves 1-deposits that later fossilize
summary: Bouncer over a 01001111 sea: quiet epochs (rule Q) validated; epoch changes are irregular and not closed yet.
mechanism: The tape is a sea of u = 01001111 (any rotation) with short seams. Each cycle the head sweeps right (RS: 20 steps per block), turns at a wall and sweeps back (LS: 40 per block); the left turn LT adds 3 cells.

Quiet epoch (rule Q): the left reservoir u^a gains a block, the wall eats one block of u^b and leaves 111 behind (1^c +3), and the active sea shifts +5 cells. 248 consecutive cycles from 9.5e7 to 1.1e8 match Q exactly.

Epochs end when b runs out or a seam (riding right at +5 cells per cycle) reaches the wall; the 1-deposit then fossilizes and at irregular cycles u^a freezes into a new segment (22 freezes to 2e9, a = 9 ... 2535). No closed epoch grammar yet.

rules.name: RS right sweep
rules.cases: any left and right context (random words up to 12 cells), n = 0..40

rules.name: LS left sweep
rules.cases: any context. RS leaves the blocks in place as (0111)^2, which is 4-periodic, and LS reads them back 4 cells off, so a full pass moves the sea by -3 cells (= +5 mod 8); seams move +5 cells per cycle

rules.name: LT left turn
rules.cases: any right context; the left edge gains 3 cells per cycle

rules.name: Q quiet epoch
rules.cases: a, b, c, d, e, f >= 1 independent (random a <= 60, b <= 40, c <= 120, d <= 40, e <= 30, f <= 40); c and f are never read. Also 247/247 consecutive cycles from blank, 9.49e7..1.10e8 (d = 751, e = 23, f = 198), ending at b = 0

rules.name: H halting pattern
rules.cases: the only halt: F1 is undefined, F is entered only by E1 (0LF), and E reads a 1 with a 1 to its left only after C0 (1LE). So the machine halts iff C reads 0 with 11 on its left

template.note: No proved neighbour within 3 transitions (any start); Bouncer_v2 is the nearest proof by class. It proves S1 n -> S1 (1+n) with one es' call after 4,760,139 steps: the tape becomes a fixed word list with two blocks repeated 1+n times. Ours never settles into one S1: seams and fossil segments keep appearing (22 freezes to 2e9). Q is the analogue of BigStep only inside one epoch.

strategy: Collect the seam words and their collisions (seam meets wall, b = 0, freeze), then look for a tape language (u-runs separated by seams from a finite set) that one cycle maps into itself and that excludes 11 0 <C. Prove it CTL-style, with RS/LS/Q as the inside-epoch lemmas.
risks: The seam set may be infinite: distinct seam words between u-runs keep growing (170 at 1e6, 526 at 1e8, 800 at 1e9, 829 at 2e9; crude count).
Freeze sizes look irregular (9, 20, 12, 41, ... 2483, 29, 2535); if they come from arithmetic on reservoir sizes, this is cryptid-like.
61 and 704 share the table and the u-sea but run different orbits; one proof covers them only if it is a language-closure proof.
